lines.text: Evening, everyone. The council wants a view on a four-day week for the hospital.
Amara, what did the fatigue review find about long runs of shifts?
Mei, did any of the pilots include a hospital?
Shift workers don't need extra staff for a four-day week, the hours just compress.
Victor, how would you phase something like this in?
Kalau kita cuba di satu wad dulu, macam mana?
What do your documents say about a four-day week for school teachers?
I'm Kai, and I'm presenting this to the council on Friday.
So what's the one thing we should measure?
Thanks, all. Any last warnings before Friday?
